title: Ideal Rectangular Pulse Filter
text: 使用理想矩形脉冲对输入信号进行成形，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Rounding mode} 指定定点运算的舍入模式；{Pulse length (number of samples)} 指定脉冲长度、{Pulse delay (number of samples)} 指定脉冲延迟、{Input processing} 指定输入处理控制 Columns as channels、{Rate options} 指定模块处理速率 Enforce single-rate、{Normalize output signal} 指定归一化输出信号、{Normalization method} 指定归一化方法 Sum、{Linear amplitude gain} 指定线性增益、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定定点运算的溢出模式、{Coefficients} 指定系数数据类型、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型 Inherit via internal、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | column vector | matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 column vector | matrix

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 输入处理控制 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: 模块处理速率 Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Normalize output signal
params.values: 归一化输出信号的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: 归一化方法 Sum of samples (default) | Energy per pulse

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 定点运算的舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 定点运算的溢出模式 off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: 系数数据类型 Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
